name: MYOB
description:
See how your business is performing, directly from your conversation. MYOB MCP gives you a fast, read-only view of your MYOB Business numbers, from profit and loss to sales, receivables and payables, with plain-language summaries and clear tables. Make MYOB a native part of your AI workflow.

Note. This feature is currently in beta.

_published_faq.name: How do I add MYOB to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add MYOB to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://mcp.myob.com/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the MYOB MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: MYOB provides these MCP tools: myob_get_financial_year_dates, myob_get_outstanding_customer_balances, myob_get_outstanding_payables, myob_get_profit_loss, myob_get_sales_invoice_totals, and myob_get_standard_payment_terms.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to MYOB?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to MYOB in financial-services on the Manufact MCP catalog include Contract-Factory — Sociétés & SIREN, Kavara Kirk, CeylonCharts, Netzo, and Ramp Data.
MYOB requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
MYOB is developed by MYOB. It is listed as partner on the Claude connector directory.
